title: Travel Insurance for Tanzania
excerpt: What should your travel insurance cover for a safari, a beach holiday or a climb in Tanzania? A checklist.
body:
Good travel insurance is essential for Tanzania. These points are worth checking.

## Medical costs

Your policy should cover medical costs abroad and repatriation.

## Evacuation

On safari, you are often far from hospitals. Medical evacuation by air can be very expensive. Check whether it is covered, or consider a membership with an evacuation service.

## Activities

Check that safari, snorkelling, diving and trekking are covered. For Kilimanjaro, see [travel insurance for Kilimanjaro](/blog/kilimanjaro-travel-insurance/).

## Cancellation

Cancellation insurance covers costs if you cannot travel. Check the conditions.

## Luggage

Check limits for cameras and electronics.

## Zanzibar

Zanzibar has a mandatory inbound insurance. See [Zanzibar entry requirements](/blog/zanzibar-entry-requirements/).

## Carry details

Have your policy number and emergency number on paper and on your phone.
